summary.text: Foy Gadberry is a Republican member of the Louisiana House of Representatives representing District 15, which the legislature's member page lists as covering Ouachita Parish. First elected in 2019, Foy Gadberry chairs the Municipal, Parochial and Cultural Affairs Committee and sits on the House and Governmental Affairs Committee.

paragraphs.text: The House page lists Foy Gadberry's occupation as civil engineer and land surveyor, with a B.A. in architecture and a B.S. in civil engineering.

The House page lists Foy Gadberry's committee assignments as Municipal, Parochial and Cultural Affairs (chair) and House and Governmental Affairs, and caucus and delegation affiliations as Louisiana Republican Legislative Delegation and Louisiana Rural Caucus.
